description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - stove watch: an attention-outsourcing cooking watcher - register up to three pots by looking at them, each bound to a head heading with its own countdown; all timers run in view while you chop and prep, a pot that runs out is called out once by its direction relative to you and stays on screen until you look back at it (or tap ACK); an optional omnidirectional level watch nudges you once when the kitchen stays loud for a while - loudness only, never boiling detection; timers live only while the agent is open and nothing is stored
name: stove-watch
